item.title: Black Friday 2026 Tech Deals: The Hardware Worth Buying Today
item.description: Sifting through inflated discounts reveals genuine hardware bargains. Here are the top verified discounts across displays, handhelds, and mobile computing.

item.title: GTA VI's launch has not yet dented Steam or Roblox, early data shows
item.description: Sensor Tower forecast a 10% drop in rival games' daily players. Early Steam and Roblox data barely moved, but PC isn't getting GTA VI, so it settles little.

item.title: Take-Two says GTA VI hit $3.79B on day one. Read the footnote first
item.description: Take-Two's $3.79 billion day-one figure for GTA VI is a company estimate of retail spending, pre-orders included. It is not revenue, and not a single day of sales.

item.title: GTA VI's 212 GB install eats most of a 512 GB Series S
item.description: Rockstar says GTA VI needs up to 212 GB of free space. On a 512 GB Xbox Series S, that math leaves little room for anything else.

item.title: Rockstar shipped two GTA VI updates before launch with no patch notes
item.description: Two mandatory downloads landed before GTA VI unlocked, and Rockstar explained neither. The file sizes hint at what changed, but they can't say why or what players will notice.

item.title: Best Ultrawide Monitors in 2026: Tested for Gaming, 5K, and Work
item.description: From high-refresh QD-OLED panels to 120Hz 5K2K productivity hubs, ultrawide displays have matured. These are the standout monitors worth buying in late 2026.

item.title: PSN sign-ins stumbled on GTA VI's eve, and Sony still hasn't said why
item.description: PlayStation Network logged thousands of outage complaints just before GTA VI unlocked. Sony offers no cause, and nothing yet ties the trouble to the game.

item.title: Sensor Tower puts GTA VI at 24.6M copies, but Take-Two hasn't confirmed
item.description: A tracker says GTA VI sold about 24.6 million copies and $2.36 billion by launch day. It's an estimate with real gaps, and Take-Two hasn't confirmed a number.

item.title: Nearly one in five workers plan time off for GTA VI, CNBC reports
item.description: GTA VI is moving PTO calendars, streaming forecasts and analyst models before it ships. The strongest claims are survey and consultancy projections, not sales data.

item.title: What GTA VI's launch means for Take-Two's $8 billion year
item.description: Take-Two's whole fiscal year hangs on one release. Its outlook is $8 to $8.2 billion in net bookings, and it has not raised that number yet.

item.title: GTA VI scores a 99 on Metacritic, matching Ocarina of Time's record
item.description: Critics have almost uniformly praised Grand Theft Auto VI, with IGN and GameSpot both giving it a 10. The complaints are about pacing, restrictive missions, and 30fps.

item.title: GTA VI launches today on PS5 and Xbox, and PC players still wait
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI is out on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has given PC players no date at all.

item.title: GTA VI runs at 30fps on every console, PS5 Pro included
item.description: Rockstar's target is 30 frames per second on PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X|S, with no 60fps mode. The Pro gets sharper visuals instead.
